behavior: hygiene is a composite of bash run steps with no action and no token, installs dotf at a pinned version from the public release checked against checksums.txt, and runs the lessons check behind an input.
verification: bats tests/hygiene.bats --filter 'inputs and their defaults|no input names|bash run step|only when lessons|install'

behavior: On a repository whose lessons pass the lessons check is green; a lesson number used twice makes it red, naming the file.
verification: dotf lessons fmt --check --dir tests/fixtures/lessons/clean && dotf lessons fmt --check --dir tests/fixtures/lessons/duplicate-number 2>&1 | grep -q 'lesson-001-same-number.md' && bats tests/hygiene.bats --filter 'lessons step|smoke-hygiene'

behavior: On a repository with an action pinned by tag, in a workflow or a local composite action, the pinned-actions check is red, naming the line.
The composite runs on one GitHub and one Gitea repository.
verification: gh run list -R mlorentedev/ci-workflows -w lint.yml -b main -s success -L 1 --json databaseId -q '.[0].databaseId' | grep -q .

behavior: Every repository that adopted the composite carries no vendored check-lessons.sh or check-actions-pinned.sh.
verification: echo 'recorded per adopter PR in verification.md' && exit 1
